versions.changelog:
Initial release of the ECC essentials bundle.

- Installs 23 core ECC skills for agentic engineering, security, deployment, workflows, and tool enhancement in a single step.
- Includes a Python installer script for easy setup, uninstallation, and customizable install paths.
- All skills sourced from affaan-m/everything-claude-code v1.9.0 (2026-03-20).
